page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7a.16xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.55 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong capabilities in multi-core processing and memory operations. The instance achieves top-tier results in stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and PassMark CPU tests, including extended instructions and encryption. Memory bandwidth for small cached blocks is highly efficient, though large-block read and write speeds fall into the average range. It also demonstrates strong performance in specific workloads such as database operations, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, ray tracing, and image processing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7a.16xlarge offers a high-density resource profile suitable for enterprise workloads without the premium cost of specialized memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. The lack of bundled local storage means storage costs are decoupled, allowing for flexible scaling of external block storage. This configuration is highly suited for multi-threaded applications, database hosting, medium-scale LLM inference, and general-purpose enterprise applications.
